title: T-1 KV facade opens against the elicited KV binding on boot and emits facadeReady
asA: shelf consumer applying the platform-cloudflare-kv v1.0.0 blueprint on a Workers project using the cf-platform fixture
iWant: one KV facade module (src/kv-facade.mjs) that opens against the elicited KV binding on process boot and emits a facadeReady lifecycle event with a metadata-only payload
soThat: boot ordering is observable, the ready-check seam is a single call site, and the applied project can compose its own bootstrapping around one predictable event

acceptanceCriteria.description: On process boot, the facade opens against the elicited KV binding (env.CACHE on the fixture) with a bounded list(limit:1) ready-check; once the ready-check resolves, a facadeReady event fires on the injected event sink with a payload of exactly {event, key, size, ttl, timestamp} where key is null, size is 0 and ttl is null. The facade exposes typed named domain verbs (get, getWithMetadata, put, delete, list) and does NOT re-export the raw KV binding.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a Node or Worker process with the facade module imported and its factory invoked with the elicited binding
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process boots and the facade ready() call resolves
acceptanceCriteria.then: a facadeReady event fires on the injected event sink with the metadata-only payload; the facade exposes named domain verbs only; the raw binding is not re-exported
